name: User Execution
summary: Adversaries may rely on a targeted organizations user interaction for the execution of malicious code. User interaction may consist of installing applications, opening email attachments, or granting higher permissions to documents. Adversaries may embed malicious code or visual basic code into files such as Microsoft Word and Excel documents or software installers. Execution of this code requires that the user enable scripting or write access…

analytics.name: Analytic 1923
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a user-invoked action on an Industrial Control System (ICS) workstation immediately followed by a process execution chain inconsistent with normal ICS operations -- the user-driven trigger plus the resulting anomalous execution chain together distinguish this from generic malware execution. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. analytics.name: Analytic 2150
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a user-facing application on an ICS Linux workstation spawning a child process outside the expected application-child baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2220
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) embedded device executing a sequence of operations inconsistent with its programmed logic, correlating temporally with an operator interaction on an engineering terminal connected to the device. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
